title: CROWNFUL Food Scale, 11 lb Digital Kitchen Scales with Built-in Coin Battery, Weight Ounces and Grams for Cooking and Baking, 6 Units with Tare Function, LCD Display, 304 Stainless Steel
description:
About this item
Smart Design with Battery Included: Features a 2-minute auto-off function to save power, plus low battery and overload indicators. Crafted from 304 food-grade stainless steel with non-slip rubber feet for stability
6 Measurement Units: Easily switch between 6 units (g/kg/lb/oz/ml/milk ml), including a dedicated mode for measuring milk volume
Precision Weighing: Equipped with 4 high-precision sensors, providing accurate measurements up to 5 kg/11 lb with 1 g increments. Includes a tare function to measure ingredients without the container weight
Clear Backlit LCD Display: Read measurements effortlessly, even in dim lighting, with a large, easy-to-read white-on-black digital display
Reliable After-Sales Support: Customer satisfaction is our TOP priority. We're here to help with any questions about your digital food scale. Certified for FCC, CE, and RoHS compliance
› See more product details
reviews_5s:
I’ve been using the CROWNFUL Digital Food Scale for a few weeks now, and it’s been a game-changer in my kitchen. The scale offers precise measurements up to 11 lbs (5 kg) with 1g increments, making it perfect for both cooking and baking. I appreciate the six-unit conversion feature (g, kg, oz, lb, ml, and milk ml), which adds versatility. The tare function is incredibly handy, allowing me to zero out the weight of containers easily. Its compact design fits neatly in my drawer, and the stainless steel surface is easy to clean. The clear LCD display is easy to read, and the auto-off feature helps conserve battery life. Overall, it’s a reliable and affordable scale that meets all my kitchen needs.I picked up the Cownful 11lb Digital Scale and I’m honestly impressed. It’s small but packs a punch when it comes to precision. Whether you're weighing ingredients for a recipe, your bag before a flight, or just seeing if you’re really as light as you feel after a salad, this scale has got your back.

The digital readout is clear and easy to read, and I love how it’s so lightweight and portable.

It might not weigh elephants, but for its size and price? It's a little powerhouse.
